ddinter.reason: Released client has no reviewed general endpoint override; source must remain disabled until denied-network delivery is proved.

gencc.reason: The released override is conditional: debug builds accept BIOMCP_GENCC_BASE; release builds require BIOMCP_TEST_UNPACED_ORIGIN to match an exact loopback origin. A lone base override does not isolate a release binary.

clingen_cspec.reason: Released manifest and linked document URL delivery requires the exact-loopback BIOMCP_CSPEC_FIXTURE_ORIGIN guard in provider_url_policy.rs; no ordinary env_base override exists.

ema.reason: The fixed EMA index precedes report downloads and has no general endpoint override. BIOMCP_EMA_REPORT_BASE does not isolate it.

BIOMCP_GENCC_BASE.guard: fixture_override_allowed requires the matching BIOMCP_TEST_UNPACED_ORIGIN on release builds

BIOMCP_CSPEC_FIXTURE_ORIGIN.guard: cspec_fixture_origin requires an exact pathless loopback origin; CspecClient applies it to manifest and linked document URLs

BIOMCP_S2_PDF_FIXTURE_ORIGIN.guard: s2_pdf_fixture_origin requires an exact pathless loopback origin for a provider-supplied PDF URL

BIOMCP_TEST_UNPACED_ORIGIN.guard: validate_article_destination accepts an exact loopback test origin; this does not replace arbitrary publisher assets
